description: A subtle Hidden Mickey appears as a three-circle star pattern on a space-themed control panel graphic during the ride. The shape is formed by a bright central star with two smaller light points positioned nearby, making it easy to miss during motion.

whereToLook.scene: Space-themed control panel mural visible during the ride
whereToLook.exactSpot: Star cluster on the purple space background near the control panel edge

bestTip: Look for it when the ride briefly slows or pauses. The motion makes this one easy to miss on a first ride.
funFacts: This Hidden Mickey relies on star placement rather than a drawn outline, blending naturally into the space scenery.

viewing.notes: Easiest to spot during a brief slow-down or pause.
